header.title: Popconfirm
header.description: Confirmation bubble shown next to the button that opens it. Asks to confirm an action without opening a modal: delete an item, discard changes or publish. The action runs only after confirming.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props and open the bubble. The buttons say `Confirm` and `Cancel` by default; pass `confirmLabel` and `cancelLabel` to change them.

texts.title: Delete this project?
texts.description: Its files and tasks are deleted too.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: Wrap the button with `Popconfirm` and pass `title`. Clicking opens the bubble; `onConfirm` runs only if the user confirms. It uses the `danger` tone by default and focus goes to Cancel.

texts.title: Delete this file?
texts.description: You won't be able to recover it.

placements.title: Placement
placements.description: `placement` picks the side: `top` (default), `bottom`, `left` or `right`. It doesn't flip when space runs out: it only shifts to stay on screen. Pick the side based on where the button is.

tones.title: Tones
tones.description: `tone` sets the icon and the confirm button variant: `danger` for destructive actions, `warning` for actions with consequences and `primary` for neutral confirmations.

warning.title: Discard the changes?
warning.description: You'll lose anything you haven't saved.

primary.title: Publish the article?
primary.description: It will be visible to everyone.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` accepts `md` (default) and `sm`, more compact for tables and lists.

texts.title: Archive the conversation?
texts.description: You can restore it from Archived.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: `icon` replaces the tone icon. `hideIcon` (or `icon={null}`) hides it.

withoutCancel.title: Without cancel
withoutCancel.description: With `showCancel={false}` only the confirm button remains. It can still be closed with Escape or an outside click.

async.title: Async confirmation
async.description: If `onConfirm` returns a promise, the button shows a spinner and the bubble stays open until it settles. Meanwhile it can't be cancelled or closed with Escape or an outside click.

texts.title: Delete the team?
texts.description: Members lose access to their projects.

error.title: Confirmation error
error.description: If the promise rejects, the bubble stays open to retry, but the component doesn't show the error. Report it yourself before rethrowing, for example with a toast. The first attempt in this example fails.

customButtons.title: Custom buttons
customButtons.description: `confirmButton` and `cancelButton` accept an element, which receives the click, or a function that receives `ref`, `onClick`, `disabled`, `isLoading` and `className`. For small changes, `confirmProps` and `cancelProps` are enough.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: With `open` and `onOpenChange` you manage the state. Useful to open the bubble from elsewhere, such as a shortcut or an external button.

initialFocus.title: Initial focus
initialFocus.description: On open, focus goes to Cancel to prevent accidental confirmations. With `initialFocus="confirm"` it goes to Confirm; use it only for safe actions.

texts.title: Save the draft?
texts.description: You can keep editing it later.

list.title: In a list
list.description: A common case: icon-only buttons to delete rows. Each button needs an `aria-label` saying what it deletes. Use `size="sm"` and `placement="left"` so the bubble doesn't cover the row.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `disabled` prevents opening, but doesn't disable the button. Pass `disabled` to the button too so it looks and is announced as disabled.

header.title: Popconfirm API
header.description: API reference for the Popconfirm React component: props, render props, CSS classes, variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath. `confirmVariantForTone` returns the confirm button variant for each tone, and `resolvePopconfirmPosition` computes the bubble position.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: It doesn't forward loose HTML attributes. className and style go to the bubble, wrapperClassName to the trigger wrapper and classNames adds classes to each part. The default buttons are Button: confirmProps and cancelProps accept its props except children and onClick.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.role: The bubble has role="alertdialog", with aria-labelledby pointing to title and aria-describedby to description.
a11y.trigger: The button gets aria-haspopup="dialog", aria-expanded and aria-controls. Its click doesn't run the default action: a submit button won't submit the form.
a11y.focus: On open, focus goes to Cancel (or Confirm with initialFocus="confirm"). On close or confirm it returns to the button.
a11y.keyboard: Tab cycles between both buttons without leaving the bubble and Escape closes it, unless closeOnEscape={false}.
a11y.labels: The buttons say "Confirm" and "Cancel" by default. Pass translated confirmLabel and cancelLabel.
a11y.async: While an onConfirm promise is pending, Confirm shows isLoading and the bubble can't be closed. If it fails, the error isn't shown: report it yourself.
a11y.disabled: disabled prevents opening, but the button stays active. Disable it too.
a11y.custom: With confirmButton or cancelButton as a function, wire ref so focus works, and disabled and isLoading to block the pending action.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.panel: Bubble, rendered in a portal. Receives `className`, `style` and `classNames.panel`.
rules.placement: Bubble side: `--top`, `--bottom`, `--left` or `--right`. Positions the arrow.
rules.sm: Compact size. There's no class for `md`.
rules.ready: Added once the position is computed; enables the enter animation.
rules.header: Row with the icon and the text. Receives `classNames.header`.
rules.title: Title. Receives `classNames.title`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Popconfirm has a single variable of its own. For the background, border or radius, redefine the tokens on the bubble so the arrow changes along with the panel.

items.--gem-popconfirm-icon: Icon color. Set by the tone classes.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: gem-system tokens used by Popconfirm, besides the button ones.

items.--gem-space-3: Padding and gap between icon and text.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: Component props and the function you can pass to `confirmButton` or `cancelButton`.

items.title: Question in the bubble.
items.children: A single element that opens the bubble on click.
items.placement: Preferred side. Doesn't flip when space runs out.
items.offset: Distance in pixels between the button and the bubble.
items.confirmProps: Extra props for the confirm button. `variant` overrides the tone one.
items.cancelProps: Extra props for the cancel button.
items.confirmButton: Replaces the confirm button: an element or a function.
items.cancelButton: Replaces the cancel button: an element or a function.
items.initialFocus: Button that receives focus on open.
items.disabled: Prevents opening. Doesn't disable the button.
items.wrapperClassName: Extra classes for the trigger wrapper.
items.onOpenChange: Runs on open or close, with the new state.
items.onConfirm: Runs on confirm. If it returns a promise, the bubble waits for it to settle.
items.onCancel: Runs on cancel, Escape or an outside click.

items.ref: Button ref. Wire it so focus works.
items.onClick: Confirms or cancels. Wire it to your button click.
items.isLoading: `true` on the confirm button while the promise is pending.
